approaches.title: Bounded presence-table scan
approaches.summary: Uses a fixed boolean table to record values, then scans positive multiples of k in ascending order to find the first unseen one. The later revision simplifies the scan condition without changing the strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial solution scaffold with the method left unimplemented.
Introduces a boolean presence table and scans multiples of k up to the bounded value limit.
Simplifies the scan by continuing while the current multiple is present and within the table.
